technical_notes.transport: All Phase 8 servers use STDIO transport (npm packages)
technical_notes.package_management: npx with -y flag for automatic installation
technical_notes.environment_variables: All use ${VAR} substitution pattern from environment
technical_notes.consistency: Follows exact pattern from Phase 7 servers
technical_notes.documentation: Comprehensive capability lists based on official API documentation
technical_notes.authentication: API key authentication (Amplitude: API key + secret + project ID, Mixpanel: project token + API secret + service account, Segment: write key + access token + workspace slug, PostHog: API key + host + project ID)

integration_highlights.amplitude: Product analytics leader - 3,200+ customers including Microsoft, PayPal, Peloton. Deep behavioral analytics with 47 tools for user engagement, retention, and conversion optimization.
integration_highlights.mixpanel: Advanced analytics platform - 8,000+ customers including Uber, Netflix, Samsung. 49 tools with predictive analytics, JQL queries, and cross-platform tracking.
integration_highlights.segment: CDP market leader - 25,000+ companies including IBM, Intuit, GAP. Unified data collection with 300+ destinations, identity resolution, and reverse ETL for 42 comprehensive tools.
integration_highlights.posthog: Open-source analytics platform - privacy-first alternative with self-hosting option. 47 tools combining analytics, session replay, feature flags, and experiments in one platform.

product_analytics_pipeline.description: Comprehensive product analytics with Amplitude, Mixpanel, and Segment
flow: Segment: Unified event tracking from web, mobile, and server
Segment: Send events to Amplitude and Mixpanel destinations
Amplitude: Track user behavior and create engagement cohorts
Amplitude: Analyze conversion funnels for key user journeys
Mixpanel: Deep-dive user journey analysis with JQL queries
Mixpanel: Create retention cohorts for at-risk users
Amplitude: Calculate LTV and revenue metrics by cohort
Mixpanel: Run predictive analytics to identify churn signals
Segment: Export high-value user cohorts to marketing tools
Slack: Weekly analytics digest with key metrics and insights

feature_launch_workflow.description: Feature rollout with A/B testing using PostHog and analytics tracking
flow: Linear: Create feature launch ticket and requirements
PostHog: Create feature flag for gradual rollout (10% → 50% → 100%)
PostHog: Set up experiment with control and treatment groups
Amplitude: Track feature engagement events and user adoption
PostHog: Monitor session replays for usability issues
Mixpanel: Analyze user journey changes with new feature
Amplitude: Compare retention between flag-on and flag-off users
PostHog: Check experiment results for statistical significance
PostHog: Roll out to 100% if positive impact confirmed
Linear: Update ticket with experiment results and next steps

user_churn_prevention.description: Identify and prevent user churn with behavioral analytics
flow: Mixpanel: Run predictive analytics to identify churn signals
Amplitude: Create behavioral cohort of at-risk users (low engagement)
Mixpanel: Analyze user journey paths leading to churn
Amplitude: Calculate days since last active session per user
Segment: Export at-risk cohort to Intercom for outreach
Intercom: Send automated re-engagement campaigns to at-risk users
Amplitude: Track re-engagement campaign effectiveness
Mixpanel: Monitor retention improvement in targeted cohort
Segment: Sync retained users back to marketing tools
Amplitude: Calculate ROI of churn prevention campaign

growth_experimentation_workflow.description: Rapid experimentation and optimization with full analytics stack
flow: Notion: Document experiment hypothesis and success metrics
PostHog: Create A/B test with variants and targeting rules
Segment: Track experiment events across all user touchpoints
Amplitude: Monitor real-time experiment metrics and sample size
PostHog: Watch session replays for qualitative insights
Mixpanel: Deep-dive into user segments and behavior changes
Amplitude: Calculate statistical significance and confidence intervals
PostHog: End experiment and roll out winning variant
Notion: Document experiment results and learnings
Segment: Update user traits with experiment group assignments

data_pipeline_management.description: Complete data pipeline from collection to activation with Segment
flow: Segment: Collect events from web, mobile, and server sources
Segment: Validate events against tracking plan schema
Segment: Send raw events to data warehouse (Snowflake/BigQuery)
Segment: Stream events to Amplitude for product analytics
PostgreSQL: Query warehouse for user segments and computed traits
Segment: Create computed traits from warehouse queries
Segment: Build audiences based on behavior and computed traits
Segment: Sync audiences to Mailchimp via Reverse ETL
Mailchimp: Create targeted campaigns for high-value segments
Segment: Track campaign performance and close the loop

competitive_advantages.amplitude: Most comprehensive behavioral analytics with 43 trillion events analyzed, 3,200+ enterprise customers, real-time cohort computation
competitive_advantages.mixpanel: Most advanced query engine (JQL) with predictive analytics, 8,000+ customers, sub-second query response times
competitive_advantages.segment: Largest CDP with 300+ destinations, 25,000+ companies, industry-leading identity resolution and data quality
competitive_advantages.posthog: Only fully-featured open-source alternative with self-hosting, combines analytics + session replay + feature flags + experiments in one platform

amplitude.challenge: Free plan limited to 10M events/month, Growth plan ($49/month) for advanced features
amplitude.solution: Documented plan tiers and event limits in .env.example with upgrade path

mixpanel.challenge: Free plan has limited features, Growth plan required for JQL queries and predictive analytics
mixpanel.solution: Documented feature availability by plan tier and cost structure

segment.challenge: Free plan limited to 1,000 MTU (Monthly Tracked Users), Team plan ($120/month) for production use
segment.solution: Documented MTU limits and destination restrictions per plan tier

posthog.challenge: Cloud plan charges per event ($0.000225/event), self-hosting requires infrastructure management
posthog.solution: Documented both cloud and self-hosted options with cost comparisons and setup guides

security_considerations.api_key_protection: All API keys stored in environment variables, never in code or version control
security_considerations.rate_limiting: Documented rate limits for all servers (Amplitude: 30 req/sec, Mixpanel: 2000/hr, Segment: 500/sec, PostHog: 100/sec)
security_considerations.data_encryption: All API communications use HTTPS/TLS encryption
security_considerations.access_scoping: Minimum required permissions documented for each server
security_considerations.credential_rotation: Recommend regular API key rotation for production environments
security_considerations.pii_handling: Segment privacy settings and consent management for GDPR/CCPA compliance

adoption_recommendations.enterprise: Full stack (Segment CDP + Amplitude + Mixpanel) for comprehensive data platform
